sdk_use_comparison.framework: Instantiates official MCP server/client/tool/transport types and official A2A protobuf/card resolver/client factory/route/gRPC types in isolated adapters.
sdk_use_comparison.custom: Pins both SDKs but only lazily imports package roots as presence markers; protocol mapping, transport, negotiation and JWS behavior are custom.
sdk_use_comparison.assessment: Framework use removes more wire maintenance. It also accepts greater SDK/transitive coupling and still cannot delegate enterprise trust or effect controls.

equivalent_protocol_benchmark.candid_assessment: This is a contract CPU microbenchmark, not protocol or service latency. It excludes SDK transport, network, TLS, PostgreSQL, Temporal and peer work, so it cannot establish production performance parity.
